subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do workflow/security owners approve the upgraded `openai/codex-action` and other secret-bearing action revisions for workflows that pass repository credentials?
rationale: This is an upstream code-execution and credential-boundary acceptance decision; it cannot be safely resolved by an automated mechanical repair or by the Dependabot release notes alone.

options.title: Audit and approve the revisions
options.body: Review the exact pinned upstream commits and accept the update after a redacted final-head workflow run confirms the affected paths.

options.title: Split secret-bearing updates
options.body: Land ordinary action bumps separately and hold the Codex, GitHub App token, and registry-login action revisions for focused security review.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the revisions
recommendation.body: Review the exact pinned upstream commits and accept the update after a redacted final-head workflow run confirms the affected paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner group is responsible for accepting third-party workflow code that executes with repository credentials; no individual owner was established from the supplied history.
